title: Wood/Soda Fire Ceramics Class
evidence_sentence: The class pages list two introductory hand-building and hybrid classes with wood/soda firing.
summary: Two 6-week classes (Wednesday hand-building and Monday hybrid wheel/hand-building) where you make ceramic pieces and fire them in a wood kiln, with required attendance at loading, unloading, and 2+ firing shifts.
how_to_join: Register online through Square at the links provided on the pottery classes page.
commitment: 6 weeks making plus firing weekend; required loading, unloading, and 2+ 3-hour firing shifts
